verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching and checking domains, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published, so code or agents can call availability checks programmatically. The evidence is a single one-line description, though, with nothing on endpoint details or response format and no mention of rate limits. Missing for 10: documented rate limits for search/check calls, detailed endpoint documentation for availability checks, independent or hands-on corroboration that the check API works.
